activity_summary: After the play Kemp asked if the slippers were now. Phillips said Thursday. You said the Wise Man on the other bill was not a place you were going, and that the dance was not this afternoon. You went home.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked if the dance was now, and agreed to wait.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept today clear of the jig.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the other bill, and went home.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Today the stage is not yours

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The Wise Man is their bill. I am not going
